name: Invalid Email Format Rejection
description: Verify system rejects invalid email formats and displays appropriate error message.
preconditions: User is logged into the CRM system.
User navigates to the contact creation screen.
postconditions: No contact is saved in the CRM system.
expectedResult: System displays an error message indicating the email format is invalid.

invalidEmailTestCases.label: No at symbol
invalidEmailTestCases.expectedError: Please enter a valid email address.

invalidEmailTestCases.label: No domain
invalidEmailTestCases.expectedError: Please enter a valid email address.

invalidEmailTestCases.label: No username
invalidEmailTestCases.expectedError: Please enter a valid email address.

invalidEmailTestCases.label: Special characters
invalidEmailTestCases.expectedError: Please enter a valid email address.

invalidEmailTestCases.label: Multiple at symbols
invalidEmailTestCases.expectedError: Please enter a valid email address.

invalidEmailTestCases.label: Space in email
invalidEmailTestCases.expectedError: Please enter a valid email address.

invalidEmailTestCases.label: No TLD
invalidEmailTestCases.expectedError: Please enter a valid email address.

invalidEmailTestCases.label: Dot at start
invalidEmailTestCases.expectedError: Please enter a valid email address.

invalidEmailTestCases.label: Dot at end
invalidEmailTestCases.expectedError: Please enter a valid email address.

invalidEmailTestCases.label: Consecutive dots
invalidEmailTestCases.expectedError: Please enter a valid email address.
